description: Codex: Space Marines (11e) Space Wolves HEROIC RESOLVE (Champions of Fenris, 2 CP) — WP-S3. Fixture sw11e_s3_reactive (P1 Orks ACTIVE vs P2 Space Wolves, round 2; layout in tests/helpers/gen_sw11e_s3_fixtures.gd). Setup privileges: the Space Wolves player gets all three Space Wolves detachments (stratagems reloaded), auto wound allocation, the Ork player has 0 CP (no Ork stratagem windows — not under test), straight to the phase under test. The Ork player clicks the Warboss in the fight list and assigns every attack at Logan Grimnar (real clicks); enemy_targets_unit_fight opens for the Space Wolves player; a real click on 'Use on Logan Grimnar' spends 2 CP; attacks that target Logan have -1 D (EffectPrimitives.get_effect_minus_damage) until the Warboss has attacked — the effect is gone once the Warboss's fight resolved.
